plugins.name: sota-anchor
plugins.description: Finds libraries, tools and research released after your coding agent's training, before it rebuilds them from scratch: when a plan assumes something is unavailable, it searches the last year of papers, repositories and packages first. Also adds current model API IDs to each session. Needs no LLM API key.
